cleavage_agent.evidence: Samples were reduced, alkylated and digested using the S-Trap protocol (Protifi, Fairport, NY) with proteins digested o/n using trypsin in 50mM HEPES pH8.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS spectra were acquired at 70,000 resolution between m/z 400 and 1500 with MSMS spectra acquired at 17,500 fwhm following HCD activation.
